entities.name: Landshome
entities.description: Port town on the north shore of Otaria on Dominaria, noticeably depopulated by the effects of the Phyrexian plague spores.

entities.description: Continent on whose north shore Landshome lies.

entities.description: War veteran who docked at Landshome in 4205 AR.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: First Phyrexian Invasion in which Balthor and Matoc fought abroad.

events.summary: In 4205 AR, Balthor Rockfist and Matoc docked at Landshome on returning to Otaria and found it depopulated.
events.quote: the war veterans Balthor Rockfist and Matoc docked at Landshome upon their arrival back to Otaria

relations.note: Port town on Otaria's north shore.
relations.quote: Landshome is a port town on the north shore of the continent Otaria
